practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_evaluation.justification: The test includes Given-When-Then inline comments and uses a scenario-driven structure, indicating some design intent (Decision rule 1) -> compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_evaluation.justification: The test interacts only with public Grafo APIs and does not access private fields or use reflection; no signs of coupling to implementation details -> compliant.
Assertions are specific (assertNull, assertEquals) and include descriptive messages; specific assertion methods are used rather than generic assertTrue -> compliant under Decision rule 3.
The test uses succinct Given-When-Then comments that explain intent rather than obvious operations; no excessive or commented-out code present -> compliant.
The test does not use random values, current time, Thread.sleep, or external dependencies; it is deterministic given the same environment -> compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_evaluation.justification: Test uses only local Grafo instance and does not persist data or modify static state, and no cleanup is required for local-only resources -> compliant (Decision rule 3).

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_evaluation.justification: The class includes a @Category(UnitTest.class) annotation which provides categorization for the method (Decision rule 1). Labels are meaningful -> compliant.
